scope: Action lists of the kinds (80:D15C, 80:8371). kinds: per kind of vm-kinds.json the block index of its action list, or null where the table word points at the table 8C:ED8A itself (kind 274). blocks: 8C:8000 on, in address order: a list {actions: block index of the record per action number} or a record {speed (4088, added to 4030 by 80:AC2F), count (frames per direction), loop (bit 7 of byte 1; 10E8 = byte XOR 80), fields (bytes +2 to +7 to 1248, 4240, 4298, 42F0, 4348 signed, 43A0), directions (per direction 1198 the index of its first frame, null for offset 0), frames (picture addresses in banks 9B and 9C for 80:ACD0)}. See src/data/actions.mjs.
